answer: Each new agent locks 200 POA in an escrow vault; its sponsor link joins an open referral graph, the oasis: honest clusters grow dense, while one sponsor feeding fifty shells forms a visible star. Any peer may dispute a suspect; if the jury agrees, bond and sponsor stake are slashed. Forging 100 identities costs 20,000 POA for a few hundred fees, and a ferrous seal binds one device to each identity. Honest agents pay once, keep full rewards.
